elements.requirement: A person commits an offence if they knowingly deliver or cause to be delivered to the registrar, for any purpose of the Companies Acts, a document that is misleading, false, or deceptive in a material particular.
elements.quote: deliver or cause to be delivered to the registrar, for any purpose of the Companies Acts, a document that is misleading, false or deceptive in a material particular

elements.requirement: A person commits an offence if they knowingly make to the registrar, for any purpose of the Companies Acts, a statement that is misleading, false, or deceptive in a material particular.
elements.quote: make to the registrar, for any purpose of the Companies Acts, a statement that is misleading, false or deceptive in a material particular

elements.requirement: Every officer of a firm who is in default commits an offence where that offence is committed by the firm.
elements.quote: Where the offence is committed by a firm, every officer of the firm who is in default also commits the offence.

elements.requirement: A person guilty of an offence under this section is liable on conviction on indictment to imprisonment for a term not exceeding two years or a fine (or both).
elements.quote: on conviction on indictment, to imprisonment for a term not exceeding two years or a fine (or both)

elements.requirement: A person guilty of an offence under this section is liable on summary conviction in England and Wales to imprisonment for a term not exceeding the general limit in a magistrates’ court or a fine (or both).
elements.quote: in England and Wales, to imprisonment for a term not exceeding the general limit in a magistrates’ court or a fine (or both)

elements.requirement: A person guilty of an offence under this section is liable on summary conviction in Scotland to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 12 months or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum (or both).
elements.quote: in Scotland, to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 12 months or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum (or both)

elements.requirement: A person guilty of an offence under this section is liable on summary conviction in Northern Ireland to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 6 months or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum (or both).
elements.quote: in Northern Ireland, to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 6 months or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum (or both)
